ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Processes Spawned by Java.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious processes spawned from a Java host process which could indicate a sign of exploitation (e.g. log4j)

sequences.query: (parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\java\\\.exe$") AND (process_path = RGX("\\\\AppVLP\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\bitsadmin\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\certutil\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\cscript\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\curl\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\forfiles\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\hh\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\mftrace\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\mshta\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\net\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\net1\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\query\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\reg\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\regsvr32\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\rundll32\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\schtasks\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\scrcons\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\scriptrunner\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\sh\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\systeminfo\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\whoami\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\wmic\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\wscript\\\.exe$")))
